$comment: Canonical facts about the Anime Array platform. The single source these claims are repeated from, so that every page states them identically.
name: Anime Array
definition: Anime Array is a free, independent, fan-built platform of AI tools for anime fans.

properties.$comment: Framed as positive properties of the platform rather than negative claims, so the required values are unambiguous: free and ad-block-safe are true, everything else is false.
properties.revenueModel: Advertising, clearly labelled on every placement

requiredClaims.$comment: These seven claims appear in every About-level description. The repository's own content policy requires all of them and forbids the wording from drifting.
claims: No account required. For any core feature.
Hosts no video. No episodes, films, subtitles or media files.
Not affiliated with, endorsed by, licensed by or sponsored by any anime studio, publisher, licensor or rights holder.
No voice cloning. No real person's performance is reproduced.
Character replies are not canon. They are original responses in a character's voice.

nonAffiliation: Anime Array is not affiliated with, endorsed by, licensed by, sponsored by, authorised by or approved by any anime studio, manga publisher, licensor, broadcaster, distributor, streaming service or rights holder.
